what_it_does: Modern AI systems combine multiple GPUs (graphics processors used for machine learning, not just gaming) into a cluster to train models faster by splitting the work. Connecting these GPUs requires ultra-fast networks, but today's standard networking gear (like PCIe expansion slots and Ethernet switches) creates bottlenecks where information gets stuck in queues instead of flowing freely between all machines. UB-mesh is a new interconnect technology—think of it as a custom-designed nervous system for the cluster—that routes messages in a mesh pattern (like a grid where neighbors connect directly). By reducing the number of hops each message takes and optimizing link speeds, it enables all-to-all communication without the traffic jams of traditional networking, letting distributed training run faster.
